<style>
@charset "UTF-8";
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400..800&family=Inter:ital,wght@0,400..800;1,400;1,600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

.dgs-page, .dgs-page *, .dgs-page *::before, .dgs-page *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.dgs-page *{margin-top:0}

.dgs-page{
  --fd:'Syne','Inter',sans-serif;
  --fb:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --fm:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,monospace;
  --bg:#050506; --bg2:#0B0B10; --bg3:#12121A;
  --wh:#FAF8F3;
  --mu:rgba(250,248,243,.62);
  --dim:rgba(250,248,243,.38);
  --ln:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  --ln2:rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  --mg:#E91E8C; --pu:#B91E8C; --or:#FF6B35; --gn:#22C55E; --wa:#25D366;
  --grad:linear-gradient(110deg,#E91E8C 0%,#B91E8C 25%,#FF6B35 50%,#B91E8C 75%,#E91E8C 100%);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
  position:relative;
  width:100vw; max-width:100vw;
  margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw); margin-right:calc(50% - 50vw);
  background:var(--bg); color:var(--wh);
  font-family:var(--fb); font-size:16px; line-height:1.6;
  overflow-x:clip;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
}
.dgs-page ::selection{background:var(--mg);color:#fff}
.dgs-page ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px}
.dgs-page ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#000}
.dgs-page ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#26262e;border-radius:99px;border:2px solid #000}
.dgs-page ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--mg)}
.dgs-page img{display:block;max-width:100%}
.dgs-page a{color:inherit}
.dgs-page p{margin-bottom:0}

@keyframes dgshift{to{background-position:-220% 0}}
@keyframes dpulse{0%, 100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,.55)}55%{transform:scale(1.25);opacity:.85;box-shadow:0 0 0 9px rgba(34,197,94,0)}}
@keyframes dfloat{0%, 100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}33%{transform:translate(40px,-44px) scale(1.12)}66%{transform:translate(-30px,30px) scale(.92)}}
@keyframes dgrain{0%, 100%{transform:translate(0,0)}10%{transform:translate(-4%,-6%)}30%{transform:translate(5%,-3%)}50%{transform:translate(-6%,4%)}70%{transform:translate(4%,6%)}90%{transform:translate(-3%,2%)}}
@keyframes dmq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@keyframes dcue{0%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}45%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:top}55%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:bottom}100%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom}}

/* ---------- Utilities ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-wrap{width:min(1400px,calc(100% - clamp(40px,7vw,112px)));margin-inline:auto;position:relative;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-wrap--s{width:min(1020px,calc(100% - clamp(40px,7vw,96px)))}
.dgs-page .dgs-sr{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.dgs-page .dgs-sec{padding:clamp(90px,11vw,160px) 0;position:relative}
.dgs-page .dgs-sec--line{border-top:1px solid var(--ln)}
html.dgs-lock, body.dgs-lock{overflow:hidden}

.dgs-page .gt{background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:dgshift 7s linear infinite}
.dgs-page .oli{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(250,248,243,.8)}
@media(max-width:768px){.dgs-page .oli{-webkit-text-stroke-width:1px}}

/* film grain overlay */
.dgs-page .dgs-grain{position:fixed;inset:-60%;width:220%;height:220%;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;opacity:.05;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='220' height='220'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix type='saturate' values='0'/></filter><rect width='220' height='220' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.6'/></svg>");
  animation:dgrain 9s steps(10) infinite}
.dgs-page .dgs-orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(130px);opacity:.16;pointer-events:none;will-change:transform;z-index:1}

/* ---------- Custom cursor ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-cur, .dgs-page .dgs-cur2{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:99999;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:none}
.dgs-page .dgs-cur{width:8px;height:8px;background:#fff;mix-blend-mode:difference}
.dgs-page .dgs-cur2{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid rgba(250,248,243,.4);transition:width .35s var(--ease),height .35s var(--ease),background .35s,border-color .35s}
.dgs-page .dgs-cur2.hov{width:74px;height:74px;background:rgba(233,30,140,.14);border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.65)}
body.dgs-has-cur .dgs-page .dgs-cur, body.dgs-has-cur .dgs-page .dgs-cur2{display:block}
@media(pointer:coarse){.dgs-page .dgs-cur, .dgs-page .dgs-cur2{display:none!important}}

/* ---------- Type system ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:28px}
.dgs-page .dgs-eyebrow::before{content:"";width:38px;height:1px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%}
.dgs-page .dgs-eyebrow em{font-style:normal;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-h2{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(40px,6.2vw,88px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 0;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,38px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:44px 0 18px;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-sub{font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.3vw,17.5px);line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu);max-width:560px}
.dgs-page .dgs-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.35fr .85fr;gap:clamp(28px,5vw,72px);align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(48px,6.5vw,92px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-head--c{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center;justify-items:center}
.dgs-page .dgs-head--c .dgs-eyebrow{justify-content:center}
@media(max-width:900px){.dgs-page .dgs-head{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:start}}
.dgs-page .rl{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.08em;margin-bottom:-.08em}
.dgs-page .rl-i{display:block;will-change:transform}

/* ---------- Buttons & chips ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:19px 32px;border-radius:999px;
  font-family:var(--fb);font-weight:600;font-size:15.5px;letter-spacing:.01em;color:#fff!important;text-decoration:none!important;
  border:1px solid var(--ln2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .4s var(--ease),box-shadow .4s,background .4s,border-color .4s;will-change:transform}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;transition:transform .4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn:hover svg{transform:translate(3px,-3px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn--fill{background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;animation:dgshift 6s linear infinite;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 12px 38px rgba(233,30,140,.32)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn--fill:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 52px rgba(233,30,140,.48)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn--ghost{backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.55)}
.dgs-page .dgs-btn--wa:hover{border-color:var(--wa);background:rgba(37,211,102,.12)}
.dgs-page .dgs-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.dgs-page .dgs-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--ln);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu);white-space:nowrap}
.dgs-page .dgs-chip::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad)}

/* ---------- HERO ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-hero{position:relative;min-height:100svh;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(120px,14vh,170px) 0 clamp(70px,8vh,110px);background:#000}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.033) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.033) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:76px 76px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(62% 60% at 50% 42%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(62% 60% at 50% 42%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-orb1{width:640px;height:640px;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--mg),transparent 70%);top:-200px;left:-180px;animation:dfloat 26s ease-in-out infinite}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-orb2{width:520px;height:520px;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--pu),transparent 70%);top:34%;right:-190px;animation:dfloat 32s ease-in-out infinite 6s}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-orb3{width:720px;height:720px;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--or),transparent 70%);bottom:-300px;left:32%;animation:dfloat 38s ease-in-out infinite 12s;opacity:.12}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:clamp(34px,5vw,60px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-meta b{color:var(--wh);font-weight:500}
.dgs-page .dgs-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--ln2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:clamp(30px,4vw,46px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-badge i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gn);animation:dpulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-title{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(52px,10.6vw,158px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0 0 clamp(30px,4vw,48px);text-transform:uppercase}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-title .row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.18em;flex-wrap:nowrap;white-space:nowrap;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:normal}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-title .row>span{flex:0 0 auto;white-space:nowrap;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:normal}
.dgs-page .row--moves{font-size:clamp(30px,8.8vw,128px)}
.dgs-page .row--city{font-size:clamp(26px,8.2vw,120px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-rot{display:inline-grid;vertical-align:baseline;font-style:italic;font-weight:600;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.dgs-page .dgs-rot>span{grid-area:1/1;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:dgshift 5s linear infinite}
.dgs-page .dgs-rot>span:not(:first-child){opacity:0}
.dgs-page .ht-arrow{font-weight:500;font-style:normal;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(250,248,243,.85)}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:clamp(28px,5vw,80px);align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,5vw,66px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-desc{font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.35vw,18px);line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu);max-width:600px}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-desc strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;align-items:flex-start}
.dgs-page .dgs-updated{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;line-height:1.9;color:var(--dim);max-width:420px}
.dgs-page .dgs-updated b{color:var(--wh);font-weight:600;display:block;letter-spacing:.28em;margin-bottom:6px}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:6px}
.dgs-page .dgs-hero-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ln);padding-top:clamp(26px,3vw,38px);gap:18px}
.dgs-page .dgs-stat strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(26px,2.8vw,42px);letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1;margin-bottom:8px}
.dgs-page .dgs-stat span{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
.dgs-page .dgs-cue{position:absolute;right:clamp(22px,4vw,54px);bottom:clamp(24px,4vw,44px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-cue span{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);writing-mode:vertical-rl}
.dgs-page .dgs-cue i{width:1px;height:56px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--mg),transparent);animation:dcue 2.2s var(--ease) infinite}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .dgs-page .dgs-hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:start}
  .dgs-page .dgs-hero-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);row-gap:26px}
  .dgs-page .dgs-cue{display:none}
}

/* ---------- Marquee ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-mq{overflow:hidden;width:100%;border-block:1px solid var(--ln);padding:clamp(22px,3.4vw,38px) 0;background:#000;position:relative;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:dmq 48s linear infinite;will-change:transform;backface-visibility:hidden}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq:hover .dgs-mq-track{animation-play-state:paused}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq-half{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq-item{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:.14em clamp(40px,5vw,84px) .14em 0;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(30px,4.4vw,64px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq-item.alt{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(250,248,243,.55)}
.dgs-page .dgs-mq-item em{font-style:normal;margin:0 clamp(14px,1.6vw,26px);font-size:.48em;line-height:0;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:0;animation:dgshift 5s linear infinite}

/* ---------- Clients ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-clients{padding:clamp(56px,7vw,88px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);background:var(--bg);position:relative;z-index:2}
.dgs-page .dgs-clients-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:clamp(26px,4vw,54px);align-items:center}
.dgs-page .dgs-client{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;opacity:.6;filter:grayscale(1) brightness(1.6);transition:.4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-client:hover{opacity:1;filter:none;transform:translateY(-4px)}
.dgs-page .dgs-client img{max-width:120px;height:auto;max-height:44px;object-fit:contain}
@media(max-width:900px){.dgs-page .dgs-clients-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:560px){.dgs-page .dgs-clients-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

/* ---------- Manifesto / scroll-fill text ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-fill{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,50px);line-height:1.24;letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:1150px;margin-bottom:26px}
.dgs-page .dgs-fill .w{opacity:.13}
.dgs-page .dgs-fill strong{font-weight:600;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-fill strong .w{opacity:1;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.dgs-page .dgs-mani-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:clamp(36px,6vw,90px);align-items:start;margin-top:clamp(44px,6vw,80px)}
@media(max-width:900px){.dgs-page .dgs-mani-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.dgs-page .dgs-mani-side p{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:18px}
.dgs-page .dgs-mani-side strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dgs-page .dgs-inline{color:#fff;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);transition:.25s}
.dgs-page .dgs-inline:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--mg);box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(233,30,140,.4)}

/* ---------- Numbered steps ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-steps{list-style:none;margin:34px 0 0;padding:0;counter-reset:dstep}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps li{counter-increment:dstep;display:grid;grid-template-columns:72px 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,34px);align-items:start;
  padding:clamp(24px,3vw,34px) 0;border-top:1px solid var(--ln);transition:padding .4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps li:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln)}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps li:hover{padding-left:14px}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps .n{display:grid;place-items:center;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--ln2);
  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);transition:.4s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps li:hover .n{background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;border-color:transparent;color:#fff}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps .tx{font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.3vw,18px);line-height:1.8;color:var(--mu);padding-top:12px}
.dgs-page .dgs-steps .tx strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}

/* ---------- Shared cards ---------- */
.dgs-page .dgs-grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.dgs-page .dgs-grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px}
@media(max-width:1024px){.dgs-page .dgs-grid3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:680px){.dgs-page .dgs-grid3, .dgs-page .dgs-grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.dgs-page .dgs-card{position:relative;padding:clamp(30px,3.2vw,42px);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035),rgba(255,255,255,.012));
  transition:transform .45s var(--ease),border-color .45s,box-shadow .45s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.dgs-page .dgs-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:rgba(233,30,140,.42);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(233,30,140,.14)}
.dgs-page .dgs-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:var(--grad);background-size:220% 220%;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.dgs-page .dgs-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-num{position:absolute;top:26px;right:28px;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(48px,4.4vw,64px);line-height:1;
  color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(255,255,255,.14);transition:.45s var(--ease)}
.dgs-page .dgs-card:hover .dgs-card-num{-webkit-text-stroke-color:rgba(233,30,140,.5)}
.dgs-page .dgs-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:18px}
.dgs-page .dgs-tag::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad)}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(21px,1.9vw,25px);letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 12px;color:#fff;max-width:85%}
.dgs-page .dgs-card-p{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.78;color:var(--mu)}

    <p class="dgs-note" data-rv style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:16px">The best SEO company for your business should explain <strong>what will be done, why it matters, and how progress will be measured</strong>.
